sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sites"."phasefactor" AS g, AVG((CAST(("scanmesh"."geomdeltamm" - "scanmesh"."facetresmm") AS REAL) / "scanmesh"."facetresmm")) AS m1 FROM "scanmesh" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scanmesh"."zoneref" GROUP BY "sites"."phasefactor"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: scanmesh.relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing
why: (geometric deviation - mesh vertex spacing) / mesh vertex spacing: the relative difference of two quantities in mm
average of relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing per sites.phasefactor
index against the all average of average of relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanprocessing"."equipref" AS e, AVG((CAST(("scanprocessing"."memusagegb" - "scanprocessing"."remaingb") AS REAL) / "scanprocessing"."remaingb")) AS m1 FROM "scanprocessing" GROUP BY "scanprocessing"."equipref"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: scanprocessing.relative difference of RAM usage from remaining storage space
why: (RAM usage - remaining storage space) / remaining storage space: the relative difference of two quantities in GB
average of relative difference of RAM usage from remaining storage space per equipment (by equipref)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of RAM usage from remaining storage space (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanregistration"."errscale" AS g, AVG("scanregistration"."refmark") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("scanregistration"."logaccumm" - "scanregistration"."errvalmm") AS REAL) / "scanregistration"."errvalmm")) AS m2 FROM "scanregistration"  GROUP BY "scanregistration"."errscale"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
